Tall Build.name: Tall Build
Tall Build.description:
💪 Build: Tall Build
Above-average height with proportionally long limbs and torso. Creates a noticeable height advantage in any group. A frame built for reach.

🖼️ Portrait only: changes how your character looks, never your Quirk or stats.
Tall Build.traitNarrativeEffects:
Portrait: Tall frame — long vertical proportions, elevated head position, long limbs. The body fills the vertical space of the crop, looking down slightly in close frames. Female: shoulders narrow for the height and level with the hips, long slim neck, fine jaw, a light chest line on a long torso. Male: shoulders wide for the height, long neck, defined jaw, a flat chest on a long torso. Otherwise (a Mutant body plan): the character's own structure at extended height.

Visual selection only: keep the character's actual adult age, body plan and any Mutant features; never change anatomy to fit this choice. It adds no Quirk effect, injury, item, license or affiliation.
